summary: No public author gene-level result was located for the four diabetic versus three control hypothalamus libraries. The GEO download matches the registered input checksum and contains only per-library counts. Author concordance remains unassessed. All 62 downloaded files passed checksum verification, and the offline audit reproduced all nine proposal claims.
openIssues: Wiley returned HTTP 403 for the supplement to a related study of arcuate leptin-receptor protein. Its contents remain unknown, and no public record linked it to the registered RNA-seq contrast.
Public sample records identify the libraries but leave animal identity, pooling and litter allocation unresolved.
